ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring platform to detect unauthorized industrial encroachment and land use violations across Odisha industrial zones.
ideas.title: OdishaSat-LandWatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven runner-up pattern from GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite-based compliance monitoring to regional state industrial development corridors, directly appealing to technical judges valuing real-world infrastructure oversight.

ideas.pitch: Lightweight CNN-powered mobile web app for rapid offline plant disease classification tailored to regional crop varieties in Odisha.
ideas.title: OdishaAgri-Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the CONIA Hackathon winning pattern of optimized CNN architecture and low-latency inference for mobile deployment, showing immediate practical utility for local agricultural sectors.

ideas.pitch: Personalized AI interview coach and resume screening platform designed specifically for students preparing for regional state and national placement drives.
ideas.title: SkillOdisha-Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly upon the HireSenseAi runner-up pattern, focusing on high-impact student employability metrics which resonate strongly with university-organized state qualifier hackathons.

ideas.pitch: IoT sensor data ingestion and machine learning web platform predicting water quality and algal bloom risks in Odisha water bodies days in advance.
ideas.title: Mahanadi-AquaSense
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of the AquaSense IoT Hackathon by combining time-series environmental data with predictive modeling to present a clear, quantifiable public health benefit.

ideas.pitch: GPS-enabled citizen reporting and walk-to-earn micro-incentive app featuring an automated municipal dashboard for local infrastructure issue resolution.
ideas.title: Bhubaneswar-CivicPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the Chatswood AI Real-World Impact Hackathon winning pattern by pairing citizen engagement with a live administrative dashboard that local municipal evaluators can instantly test and appreciate.
